newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe dollar ends week easier on most units.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe dollar ends week easier on most units.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted weaker against most major currencies at the close of fairly quiet interbank trade on Friday, dealers said.

"The local dollar went down as far as 11.2950/3050 until the (central) Reserve Bank sold a few U.S. dollars that brought the exchange rates down again. But otherwise there was nothing much happening today," one dealer commented.
He said the local unit closed at 11.2825/2925 against the U.S. dollar, slightly down from Thursday's 11.2800/2900 and was at 18.0520/0620 from 18.0200/0400 versus pound sterling.
It slipped to 2.5470/5490 from 2.5400/5600 against the rand but edged up on the mark to 6.6660/6680 from 6.7300/7500.
